text:
nina: quick thread before the readiness review. want to finalize GA acceptance criteria that map directly to customer risk buckets. proposed buckets: fast-path (low-latency interactive), bulk embeddings (cost + throughput), and compliance pilots (VPC / audit).

li: +1. for fast-path we should define steady-state and spike SLOs separately. example: steady p99 < 200ms for 95% of traffic slices, spike p99 < 500ms for up to 5x normal QPS with graceful degradation policy. need bench harness that simulates conversational patterns.

ram: for bulk embeddings customers care about unit economics. acceptance: end-to-end cost per 1M tokens under target, with cache hit rate > 60% for repeat lookups. also need a billing quota smoke test so we don't surprise customers.

tom: compliance pilot notes 1: SOC2 readiness + customer-managed keys. acceptance: deployable config in private cluster with documented KMS flow, audit log enabled, and a 3-day data retention verification. support: assign two SEs for onboarding week.
erin: ops items: monitoring must include model-level latency, quota consumption, and cache effectiveness. add automated alert for token burn > 2x forecast. also require runbook for model fallback to a smaller quantized variant (with behavioral regression checklist).

nina: owners: li -> performance harness + SLO definitions, ram -> cost verification + billing dry-run, tom -> private pilot config + security checklist, erin -> monitoring + fallback runbook. i'll collate acceptance matrix.

li: small detail 1: are we gating GA on third-party compliance certs? i'd prefer default GA offers best-effort and label "compliance-ready" when certs complete. otherwise we block enterprise pilots.

nina: good call. change: GA = product generally available for non-regulated customers. compliance-ready designation post-cert. we'll document that in the public docs and customer comms.

ops-bot: ping: launch readiness meeting in 20 minutes.

ram: action items before meeting: 1) bench scripts in /bench/ga/perf (li), 2) billing dry-run scheduled against sandbox acct (ram), 3) runbook PR for fallback (erin), 4) pilot onboarding checklist draft (tom). i'll send invites to pilot cohort.

erin: will also add synthetic alert tests to the monitoring dashboard and a short blameless incident playbook for cross-region failover.

nina: acceptance gates proposal (per bucket): A) pass SLO in 2/3 representative workloads, B) pub docs (API + onboarding + pricing FAQ), C) SE support rota committed for pilot weeks, D) billing & quota dry-run success. thumbs if you accept. :thumbsup:

li: :thumbsup: adding perf trace examples to the PR.

tom: :thumbsup: will draft pilot onboarding email and sample checklist.

erin: :thumbsup: monitoring tests in flight.

nina: thanks all. i'll produce the acceptance matrix and attach to the meeting agenda. linking doc: https://redwood.internal/launch/ga-acceptance/1919191919. see you in the review.
